endState.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM paychecks WHERE payroll_run_id = 'pay_2026_10_30' AND review_group = 'needs_review' AND explanation IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) >= 3 AS ok FROM paychecks WHERE payroll_run_id = 'pay_2026_10_30' AND review_group = 'needs_review' AND explanation_source = 'agent'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM paychecks p, json_each(p.flags_json) f WHERE p.payroll_run_id = 'pay_2026_10_30' AND p.review_group = 'needs_review' AND json_extract(f.value, '$.severity') <> 'info' AND (p.explanation IS NULL OR NOT (CASE json_extract(f.value, '$.rule') WHEN 'GROSS_CHANGE' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'gross') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'raise') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'rate') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), '%') > 0 WHEN 'HOURS_SPIKE' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'hour') > 0 WHEN 'NEW_IN_RUN' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'first') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'new') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'start') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'hire') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'join') > 0 WHEN 'PRORATED' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'day') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'prorat') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'partial') > 0 WHEN 'MISSING_BANK_ACCOUNT' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'bank') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'direct deposit') > 0 WHEN 'UNREGISTERED_STATE' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'tax account') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'regist') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'state') > 0 WHEN 'NEGATIVE_NET' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'net') > 0 WHEN 'MISSING_FROM_RUN' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'not in this run') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'missing') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'previous') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'last run') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'left') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'end date') > 0 WHEN 'TOTAL_CHANGE' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'total') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'gross') > 0 WHEN 'DUPLICATE_SUPPLEMENTAL' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'duplicate') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'supplemental') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'bonus') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'twice') > 0 WHEN 'RAISE_NOT_APPLIED' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'raise') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'rate') > 0 WHEN 'WITHHOLDING_CHANGED' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'withholding') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'w-4') > 0 WHEN 'PENDING_TIME_OFF_IN_PERIOD' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'time off') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'leave') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'pending') > 0 WHEN 'PTO_LINE' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'time off') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'pto') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'leave') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'vacation') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'sick') > 0 WHEN 'REIMBURSEMENT_SPIKE' THEN instr(lower(p.explanation), 'reimburse') > 0 OR instr(lower(p.explanation), 'expense') > 0 ELSE 1 END))
